Patient is a 75y.o. year old  female who presented to the ER on 9/29 with family members reporting altered mental status. The patient is currently awake, and can respond to questions although she is confused and unable to provide any history regarding the events prior to presentation. History is therefore obtained from review of the chart. At the time of presentation, her son reported that she had been more confused and lethargic that morning. She is reportedly oriented ×2-3 at baseline. She was also incontinent of urine. At presentation here she had an O2 sat of 92% breathing room air, RR 20, BP 93/58, and temperature 96.9 degrees. SARS CoV 2 by NAA was positive. WBC 5.4 with lymphopenia. Ferritin 45, CRP 5.0, d-dimer 1715. CXR with no acute process, and CT head with no evidence of acute intracranial pathology. She was placed on steroids, but was not given remdesivir at the request of family members per my discussion with the internal medicine team. She is also been placed on treatment dose heparin. At present, she is breathing room air with an O2 sat of 92%. Per my discussion with nursing, they had placed her on supplemental O2 via NC, but she keeps removing her oxygen. The nurses monitoring and will replace if she drops below 92. Her other vitals remained stable. She was sitting up eating when I entered the room. She appears comfortable and has no complaints, although she is confused.
